name: War Inc: Rising Beginner Guide 2026 — First 30 Days Strategy
title: War Inc: Rising Beginner Guide 2026 — Complete First 30 Days Strategy
meta_description: New to War Inc: Rising? This beginner guide covers everything for your first 30 days: what to build, what troops to use, what to spend gems on, what to avoid, and the 16 most common beginner mistakes.
author: War Inc Wiki Team

sections.heading: The Golden Rule: Never Merge Your Last Two Copies
sections.content: This is the single most important tip in War Inc: Rising. Never merge your last two copies of a strong troop — two level 3s are better than one level 4 because you can field them in separate formations. The only exception is when you have a third copy waiting. This applies especially to Radiant Warrior, Frost Queen, Necromancer, and Bone Marksman. Top players keep two copies of these at all times.

sections.heading: Week 1-2: Foundation Phase
sections.content: Your first two weeks are about building a foundation. Castle upgrade is your ABSOLUTE #1 priority — spend ALL wood on it. Each castle level gives +50 troop energy, which a top content creator calls '10 dragons worth of power.' Complete all daily quests (5 quests, 3 resets per day). Don't spend any gems yet — save them. Use Swordsman (common melee, multi-unit splash) and Archer (common range, highest ATK) as your core troops early. They're genuinely good even at common rarity. NEVER use Wood Shield Guard, Snowball Thrower, or Gunner — they're traps. Fuse uncommon troops with gold to try for Bombs (costs gold only, no gems). Join an active clan — Heretic Sanctuary is recommended by the community.

sections.heading: Week 3-4: Gem Spending Phase
sections.content: Start spending your saved gems on the Wheel when a good mythic is featured (Radiant Warrior, Frost Queen, Bone Marksman, Necromancer, Light Seeker). The optimal strategy is to spin until you hit milestone chests at 50 or 100 pulls — never chase specific pulls. Budget ~11,000 gems per level 4 mythic from the Wheel, ~9,000 from Card Master. Meanwhile, keep fusing uncommons with gold to build Bombs — they dominate the 2,500-5,000 trophy range in PvP. Build up 8-10 level 6 Poison Masters to carry your Infinite War progression. Start co-op grinding with a clanmate (gold mine every 15s, pick different devil cards than your partner).

sections.heading: Building Priority Order
sections.content: Building upgrades follow a strict priority: Castle (Command Center) is #1 without question — each level gives +50 troop energy. Spell Cauldron unlocks at a certain castle level and is the next priority. Gold Mine increases your gold income. Sawmill increases wood income. Follower Camp should be left at level 1 — it 'isn't much use' according to top players. Daily routine: Log in, tap the building icon, collect all resources, start next castle upgrade, then queue other buildings.

sections.heading: Month 2: Targeting Mythics
sections.content: By month two you should have saved 10,000-15,000 gems. Target specific mythics based on priority: Radiant Warrior first (get minimum 2-3 copies), then Bone Marksman (get to level 4 for skill unlock), then Necromancer or Light Seeker depending on your focus (PvE vs PvP). Reach 2,500-5,000 trophies in PvP where Bombs are strongest. Participate in clan war and learn the basics. Join Dragon Clash events and pick a side IMMEDIATELY upon event start. Participate in summon events using scrolls only (never gems) — spend ~30 scrolls per event grouping. Start co-op Lucky Dice events with a mine-first strategy.

sections.heading: Month 3+: Endgame Transition
sections.content: Start investing forge stones into key troops: Ursa (level 7), Elven Archer (level 7), Oracles (level 7+ for skill range), Bone Gunner, Flame Mages, Poison Masters. Level up your Ruler in clan war — equip via Barracks → Ruler button. Core stones have a sweet spot at level 6-7 (good 2-3 star odds). Have multiple S-tier mythics at level 4+. Target top 1,000 in arena. Get involved in clan leadership and diplomacy.

sections.heading: Gem Spending: Only Two Things Worth It
sections.content: There are exactly two things worth spending gems on: the Wheel and Card Master. Everything else is a trap. Wheel: ~100 gems per spin, 4% mythic rate, milestone chests at 10/30/50/100. Budget ~11K gems for a level 4 mythic. Card Master: 250 gems per draw, 12 cards with 1 featured mythic, average 6.5 picks to find it. Budget ~9K for a level 4 mythic. NEVER spend gems on: extra Infinite War battles, extra Hunting battles, fusion at any tier, recruit/summon purchases (use scrolls only), building speed-ups, resources from the shop, non-mythic Wheels, refreshing daily missions, or random hero shards.

sections.heading: Forge Stone Strategy for Beginners
sections.content: Forge stones are the bottleneck for level 7+ upgrades. The game has implemented permanent cost reductions: Common level 7 costs only 32 stones (was 320), level 9 costs 240 (was 1,200). Rare upgrades are ~90% off. Epic level 7 costs 700 (was 960). Only invest forge stones in: Ursa, Elven Archer, Oracles, Bone Gunner, Flame Mages, Poison Masters, and select rares (Forest Scout, Flayer Warden, Goblin Shredder, Paladin, Bomber, Frost Skeleton). Upgrade one of each Common to level 7 for the 100-gem Power Stance achievement, then stop.

sections.heading: 16 Beginner Mistakes to Avoid
sections.content: Here are the most common mistakes compiled from top players and content creators. (1) Merging your last two copies of strong troops. (2) Spending forge stones on wrong troops. (3) Not picking a Dragon Clash side immediately when the event starts. (4) Merging troops too early without enough copies. (5) Spending gems on extra battles or fusion. (6) Forgetting to use the in-game name color trick (<#RGB> format). (7) Ignoring the clan war trial feature (free formation testing). (8) Not coordinating dragon times with clanmates. (9) Not using the Rope-a-Dope trick in Crimson Moon clan war. (10) Spending all gold at once — stay near your gold cap (Castle 3 = 2M, Castle 4 = 2.5M, Castle 5 = 3M). (11) Using uncommons in your main formation — they fall off quickly. (12) Wasting all recruitment on level 3 recruiting only. (13) Not checking Discord for event and troop schedules. (14) Not understanding multi-unit vs single-unit stats (multi-units show stats per individual, not total). (15) Wasting forge stones on level 7 commons beyond one each. (16) Using Wood Shield Guard, Snowball Thrower, or Gunner.

sections.heading: What Troops to Use at Each Rarity
sections.content: Commons: Swordsman (melee splash) and Archer (best range). Upgrade one each to level 7 for achievement, then stop. Never use Wood Shield Guard, Snowball Thrower, or Gunner. Rares: Forest Scout (best range), Flayer Warden (best melee), Goblin Shredder (2s stun), Paladin (shield), Bomber (suicide + stun at 7), Frost Skeleton (speed reduction). Skip Apprentice Mage, Goblin Shaman, Berserker, Werewolf. Epics: Oracles (best epic, stack as many as possible), Poison Masters (8-10 for Infinite War), Flame Mages (hunting). Legendaries: Ursa (level 7), Elven Archer (level 7), Bone Gunner. Mythics: Radiant Warrior (priority #1), Frost Queen (keep 2), Bone Marksman (get to level 4 ASAP), Necromancer (PvE king), Light Seeker (PvP destroyer).
